result.findings:
(A) EVIDENCE. Both DOIs are real and the sweep record is partly misread.

Energy Fuels 2021, 35(17), 13900-13907 (Tu et al., Crossref + OpenAlex abstract): material is Ca(C4O4)(H2O); CO2/N2 adsorption selectivity 73 for 15/85 vol at **1 bar, 298 K** (not 0.15 bar); isosteric heat **47.7 kJ/mol**; DFT says CO2 binds by **hydrogen bonds to the oxygen of the coordinated H2O**; cyclic adsorption/regeneration run under **100 % RH, 15 vol% CO2/N2**. The abstract states the mechanism is **molecular sieving** — pore diameter deliberately between the kinetic diameters of CO2 and N2. No numeric humid retention % is given in anything I could open: the sweep's "passes 100 % RH" is qualitative (미확인). 0.15 bar / 298 K CO2 uptake: 미확인. 3.2 x 4.5 A aperture and 150 C collapse: 미확인 (ACS/Nature 403/paywalled).

Chem Mater 2023, 35, 2956-2966 is **not** a supporting rigid-GCMC study. Title/abstract (OpenAlex): "Selective Uptake of Ethane/Ethylene Mixtures by UTSA-280 is Driven by Reversibly Coordinated Water Defects" — separation is kinetic, "**equilibrium conditions eliminate selectivity**", inter-channel transport goes through **local defects bearing coordinated water**, and defect density depends on activation history. Angew 2023 (10.1002/ange.202309874) independently shows incoming water **displaces the coordinated water** ("knock-off"), making the 1D channels pseudo-3D. ChemComm 2021 (10.1039/d1cc03105h) finds volumetric NTE -9.5e-6 /K — real but tiny over 75 K, so this is *not* a valid objection.

(B) FIT. Three independent blockers, any one fatal. (1) The registered CO2 site *is* the coordinated water, and that water is exchangeable with RH90 guest water — rigid GCMC freezes it, so humid working capacity is structurally wrong, not merely noisy. (2) The literature performance is kinetic sieving; our equilibrium GCMC is the exact method the Sholl paper says gives zero selectivity. With CO2 at the aperture threshold, a 1-2 % cell change from GFN-FF flips loading between excluded and filled. (3) Squarate has no substitutable ring position: batch freedom = 0, so ensembles of 5 realizations are identical structures (SD = 0) — the 배치 단위 ruler is undefined, exactly the WATER_FIX §8 degeneracy. Metal or ring-size swaps change topology, breaking fixed-topology comparison.
result.effectiveness_for_our_ruler: Ineffective — do not spend the 2-week window. Our ruler (0.15 bar, 298 K, RH90 TSA 298→373 K humid working capacity + RH90/RH0 retention) cannot be computed meaningfully here. The retention denominator depends on whether guest water displaces the framework-coordinated water, which our rigid framework forbids by construction (Angew 2023 knock-off); the TSA hot leg at 373 K sits where that coordinated water begins to leave, so the 298 K and 373 K states are not the same compound; and the material's actual selectivity is kinetic, which equilibrium GCMC is documented to erase (Chem Mater 2023). Cost is not the constraint — a handful of state points would fit easily in 24 cores x 2 weeks — the constraint is that there is no ladder to run: zero substitutable ring positions means zero batch degrees of freedom, so an ensemble of 5 realizations collapses to 5 copies of one structure, SD = 0, and our 1.5 배치 단위 threshold is undefined (same failure mode as WATER_FIX §8). At most, UTSA-280 is worth one non-registered single-point sanity calculation to see how far rigid GCMC over-predicts a sieving material — a methods footnote, not a candidate. Recommend rejecting it from the substitution-ladder program and keeping compute on ZIF-69 MTV (base RH0 0.5839 mol/kg, saIm050 retention 92.0 % n=1 / 83.5 % n=5), where the substitution axis and batch statistics are actually defined.
result.corrected_numbers: Selectivity 73 is CO2/N2 15:85 at 1 bar, 298 K — NOT at our registered 0.15 bar (sweep record omitted the pressure). Qst(CO2) = 47.7 kJ/mol, attributed by DFT to H-bonding with the coordinated H2O oxygen. Humid cycling condition is 100 % RH with 15 vol% CO2 in N2 (adsorption/regeneration cycles); no retention percentage is stated in any source I opened — 미확인, so it cannot be compared to saIm050 92.0 %/83.5 %. Formula is Ca(C4O4)(H2O), i.e. exactly one coordinated water per Ca. Sweep's attribution of Chem Mater 2023 as "rigid GCMC by Sholl group" is a misreading: that paper's conclusion is that equilibrium (rigid, defect-free) treatment eliminates the selectivity and that reversibly coordinated water defects drive it. Volumetric NTE = -9.51(5)e-6 K^-1 (ChemComm 2021) — negligible over 298→373 K, so thermal expansion is not a valid objection. 3.2 x 4.5 A aperture, 150 C collapse, and 0.15 bar/298 K uptake remain 미확인 (ACS 403, Nature paywall, EuropePMC no record).
result.cif_and_positions: CIF: obtainable in principle — the parent structure is Lin, Li, Zhou, Wu, He, Li, Krishna, Li, Zhou, Chen, Nature Materials 2018, 17(12), 1128-1133, "Molecular sieving of ethylene from ethane using a rigid metal-organic framework" (10.1038/s41563-018-0206-2), with CSD/CCDC deposition; the CCDC number itself is 미확인 (nature.com redirects to auth, ACS 403). The coordinated water IS part of the published structure (formula Ca(C4O4)(H2O)), so a CIF with framework water exists and PACMAN DDEC6 could charge it — but that is precisely the trap: it makes an exchangeable, activation-history-dependent water look like a permanent framework atom. Substitution positions: none. Squarate C4O4(2-) carries an oxygen on every ring carbon, so there is no C-H position to substitute — batch degrees of freedom = 0. Available axes are metal (Ca→Mg/Sr/Mn) and ring size (deltate C3O3 / croconate C5O5); both change the topology and cell, so neither is a fixed-topology ladder, neither is calibrated in our UFF_MOF + DDEC6 pipeline, and neither supports ensemble batch statistics.

result.findings:
(A) EVIDENCE. DOI 10.1021/jacs.9b12879 = Shi, Tao, Wu, Zhang, He, Long, Lee, Li, Zhang(YB), JACS 2020, 142, 2750-2754, "Robust Metal-Triazolate Frameworks for CO2 Capture from Flue Gas" (Crossref/PubMed 31968944). Paywalled, no OA copy (Unpaywall: closed), so all numbers below are from an OA secondary review or the abstract.

Confirmed from primary abstract: CO2/N2 thermodynamic selectivity up to 120; CO2/H2O selectivity up to 70 is explicitly **kinetic**; CO2 at channel centre, H2O at corner.

CORRECTIONS. (1) The humid test is **33 % RH, 298 K** (PMC12279785), not RH 90. (2) The material is not "ZnF(daTz) MAF" alone but a four-member fixed-topology ladder ZnF(TZ)/ZnF(aTZ)/ZnF(daTZ)/ZnF(dmTZ) on rod (Zn-F-Zn-F)n SBUs with 1D honeycomb channels (PMC13468140). (3) Uptake at 0.15 bar, 298 K: 0.27 / 0.56 / 0.96 mmol/g for TZ/aTZ/daTZ; SA 613/573/479 m2/g; Vpore 0.213/0.168/0.119 cm3/g; Qst 23.6/32.3/~33 kJ/mol (review table; its text writes "1.5 mbar", an evident typo). (4) The Anie 2025 MTV series (10.1002/anie.202512425) is a **different framework** — sulfate-pillared Zn2(daTz)2SO4, explicitly flexible (linker rotation + reversible Zn-O bond rearrangement), targeted at C2 hydrocarbons, not humid flue gas. It cannot be used as the substitution ladder.

(B) FIT. Rigid GCMC cannot produce the headline: kinetic selectivity 70 is a diffusion claim; the +25-30 % Qst is DFT with pre-adsorbed water, not an equilibrium isotherm. No equilibrium CO2/H2O co-adsorption data was found. The site segregation IS a legitimate equilibrium prediction our density_v3 grids can test. Chemisorption is not claimed (physisorption, Qst ~33). No OMS (Zn is F/N-saturated). Ladder headroom is genuine and better than ZIF-69: four experimentally known endmembers (also independently made as Zn-F-TRZ/ATRZ/DATRZ, 10.1021/acs.cgd.8b00389) plus MTV fractions for 5-realization ensembles. Blockers: no CIF in hand (CCDC numbers 미확인, ACS 403), and PLD unknown — ultramicroporous, plausibly at or under our 3.3 A Zeo++ gate.
result.corrected_numbers: CO2 @0.15 bar, 298 K: ZnF(TZ) 0.27, ZnF(aTZ) 0.56, ZnF(daTZ) 0.96 mmol/g (vs our ZIF-69 base 0.5839 mol/kg dry -> daTZ ~1.64x). CO2/N2 IAST 13 / 46 / 120 (15:85, 298 K, 0-101 kPa). Qst 23.6-24 / 32.3 / ~33 kJ/mol. BET 613 / 573 / 479 m2/g. Vpore 0.213 / 0.168 / 0.119 cm3/g. CO2/H2O kinetic selectivity 70 at 298 K, 33 % RH (NOT 90 % RH, NOT equilibrium). Qst(CO2) +25-30 % with co-adsorbed water = DFT binding-energy calculation over five CO2 sites, not measured. PLD/LCD: 미확인. All uptake/texture values are from the OA review PMC13468140 quoting ref [70]; primary JACS text/SI not readable (403, closed access).
result.cif_and_positions: CIF: not obtained. JACS 2020 is paywalled (Unpaywall is_oa=false, no repository copy); CCDC deposition numbers could not be confirmed (ccdc.cam.ac.uk API returns a bot-validation page). Crystal structures of all four members are shown in the paper (Figure 3a as reproduced in PMC13468140), so CCDC deposits almost certainly exist, but the numbers are 미확인. Independent route: the same framework family was reported as Zn-F-TRZ / Zn-F-ATRZ / Zn-F-DATRZ in Cryst. Growth Des. 2018, 10.1021/acs.cgd.8b00389, which is a second possible CIF source. Positions/topology confirmed qualitatively: rod-like (Zn-F-Zn-F)n SBUs bridged by 3-connected triazolates giving honeycomb-type 1D channels; substituents sit at triazole 3- and 5-positions (H, NH2, 2xNH2, 2xCH3). Adsorption sites: CO2 at the 1D channel centre, H2O at the channel corners; five distinct CO2 sites treated by DFT. No open metal sites (Zn coordinated by F and triazolate N).
result.effectiveness_for_our_ruler: Partially effective — the ladder fits our method better than the paper's headline fits our ruler. What we CAN do: (i) Zeo++ PLD/LCD gate on the four endmembers — this is the go/no-go and must run first, because an ultramicroporous 1D channel with 0.119 cm3/g may fail PLD > 3.3 A, and if it does the whole candidate dies before any GCMC; (ii) dry CO2 at 0.15 bar, 298 K against three published anchors (0.27/0.56/0.96) — a rare chance to validate our UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez + DDEC6 stack against a real three-point substitution trend, which ZIF-69 never gave us; (iii) RASPA density grids to test the CO2-centre / H2O-corner segregation as an equilibrium prediction — cheap, novel, and directly reportable; (iv) MTV ensembles of 5 realizations over aTZ/daTZ/dmTZ occupancy on a fixed topology, which is exactly our registered method. What we CANNOT do: the CO2/H2O selectivity of 70 is kinetic (diffusion), so rigid equilibrium GCMC cannot reproduce or refute it — do not register it as a target; and the paper's humid evidence is at 33 % RH, so our RH90 TSA ruler is an extrapolation beyond anything measured, not a reproduction. The +25-30 % Qst-with-water is a DFT number; our classical fixed-charge TIP5P-Ew treatment is a weak instrument for it, and note the fresh Hw/Lw water-force-field fix (WATER_FIX_20260906) means only v3w_* runs may be cited. Cost: small ultramicroporous cells make CO2 runs cheap (well inside 2 weeks on 24 cores for 4 endmembers x dry + RH0/RH90 x 298/373 K), but RH90 water GCMC in ultramicropores converges slowly (low insertion acceptance near saturation) — budget the water leg at 3-5x the CO2 leg and register a convergence criterion before starting. Recommended path: PLD gate -> dry 0.15 bar validation vs the three published points -> only then commit the humid/TSA and ensemble legs. Prerequisite: obtain a CIF (CCDC via institutional access, or the 2018 CGD deposits); without it nothing runs.

result.findings:
(A) EVIDENCE. Primary paper exists and is correctly cited: Chen, Leng, Ma, Wu, Jin, Yu, Huang, Shang, Ye, "Highly controllable CO2 capture performance under varied humidity conditions by finely tuned metal and organic ligand compositions of DMOF adsorbents", Micropor. Mesopor. Mater. 389, 113559 (print 2025-05) — Crossref confirmed. It is fully closed: Unpaywall is_oa=false, OpenAlex oa_status=closed and no abstract, Semantic Scholar abstract elided/CLOSED, Europe PMC hitCount=0, ScienceDirect 403/CAPTCHA. So dry-vs-humid capacities, any 0.15 bar/298 K point, the water isotherm, the RH definition, CCDC/CIF deposition, and PXRD-after-water evidence are all 미확인 from primary.
The sweep numbers trace only to the OA review (PMC13367856, 10.1039/d6sc03678c), verbatim: "The optimal Ni-TM DMOF delivers a CO2 capacity of 5.0 mmol g−1 at 273 K and 1 bar, and shows negligible performance loss under 80% RH in breakthrough experiments."[36] Correction to the candidate card: 5.0 mmol/g is 273 K / 1 bar (not our 0.15 bar / 298 K), and the humidity claim is a dynamic breakthrough at 80 % RH, not an equilibrium RH90 isotherm or a TSA working capacity — neither is commensurable with our ruler.
(B) FIT. Decisive: the parent DMOF-1 Zn2(bdc)2(dabco) is the textbook guest-flexible pillared-layer framework — the CIF already in our tree (/home/mangwon1/mof_project/00_Migration/raspa_share/raspa/structures/mofs/cif/ZnBDCdabco.cif) carries its own citation, Dybtsev/Chun/Kim, "Rigid and Flexible: ... Unusual Guest-Dependent Dynamic Behavior", Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2004 (10.1002/anie.200460712, Crossref confirmed); the same review notes Zn2(BDC)2DABCO unit-cell contraction under pressure[97]. Worse, the family's selling point is framework hydrolysis resistance conferred by methylation (cf. 10.1021/acs.jpclett.2c00693, DMOF-1 water stability), and hydrolytic degradation is exactly what rigid GCMC cannot see — we would compute only pore hydrophobicity and report it as the paper's effect. Mixed-linker DMOFs exist (10.1039/c5dt03825a) but that work tunes flexibility, the same un-modellable axis. Positive points only: dabco occupies both paddlewheel axial sites (no OMS — confirmed from the local CIF's axial Zn–N), and the BDC/2-Me/2,5-Me2/TM-BDC ladder is fixed-topology. Not enough.
result.corrected_numbers: 5.0 mmol/g is at 273 K / 1 bar (review-level claim, primary inaccessible), NOT at 0.15 bar / 298 K; our ruler point is unreported in any source opened. "80 % RH" is a breakthrough (dynamic, co-fed) condition, not an equilibrium RH90 isotherm and not a TSA 298->373 K working capacity; "negligible performance loss" is qualitative, no number available. No dry-vs-humid capacity pair, no water isotherm value, no CCDC deposition number could be confirmed — all 미확인.
result.cif_and_positions: Parent DMOF-1 CIF is already in the repo: /home/mangwon1/mof_project/00_Migration/raspa_share/raspa/structures/mofs/cif/ZnBDCdabco.cif (data_MOF-1-Dybtsev-dmol, P1, a=b=10.9288, c=9.6084 A, orthorhombic; Zn1 0.48774 0.51207 0.14773 with N1 0.48635 0.51599 0.36686 axially above it — dabco caps both paddlewheel axial sites, so no open metal site in the ideal framework). No Ni(TM-BDC)(dabco)0.5 CIF was located in any source opened; CCDC/CSD deposition for the 2025 paper is 미확인 (SI paywalled). A ladder would have to be built by our own substitution pipeline (BDC -> 2-Me -> 2,5-Me2 -> TM-BDC on the local Zn CIF, then Zn->Ni swap), i.e. all four rungs are model-generated, none literature-validated.
result.effectiveness_for_our_ruler: Low. Three independent blockers. (1) Non-comparability: the only accessible numbers (273 K, 1 bar, breakthrough at 80 % RH) sit nowhere near CO2 0.15 bar / 298 K / RH90 equilibrium + TSA 298->373 K, so there is no anchor to validate our pipeline against and no way to claim agreement or disagreement with the paper. (2) Physics outside the model: the whole grid's message is water-induced framework hydrolysis (methylation as the cure) plus guest-dependent lattice dynamics — rigid-framework GCMC reproduces neither; we would produce a hydrophobicity number and mislabel it as the paper's humidity resistance. That is precisely the "failure that looks like a result" pattern CLAUDE.md §0 warns about. (3) Unvalidated regime: Ni2 paddlewheel + open-shell Ni has never been through our PACMAN DDEC6 / GFN-FF / UFF_MOF chain; a bad charge or a collapsing relaxation would be indistinguishable from a physical result. Cost is not the blocker — a Ni-only 4-rung ladder, n=1, RH0/RH90 x 298/373 K is ~16 RASPA jobs and fits the 2-week 24-core window — but it would be preceded by an unvalidated relaxation/charge step and would answer a question the ruler does not ask. Note also that pure-composition rungs have zero placement degrees of freedom, so our ensemble-of-5 batch-statistics machinery (배치 단위) applies only to mixed-linker rungs. If a hydrophobicity ladder is genuinely wanted, methyl substitution on our already-validated rigid ZIF-69 topology delivers it without any of the above.

result.findings:
(A) EVIDENCE. JACS is 2017, 139(5) 1734-1737 (not 2016). OSTI abstract verbatim confirms: PE 655 kJ/kg CO2 (lowest reported, below Mg-MOF-74); "CO2 adsorption isotherm being unchanged following 7 days of steam-treatment (>85% RH) or 6 months of exposure"; "breakthrough experiments show that 1 only loses 7% of its maximum CO2 capacity under humid conditions". CORRECTION: the >85% RH claim is post-exposure dry-isotherm stability, not humid coadsorption; the 7% is breakthrough (kinetic, bed-scale), RH/T not stated in abstract, SI paywalled -> 미확인. The only in-situ humid CO2 exposure with data is Sci Adv: "constant stream of humidified CO2 [~30% RH] for over 48 hours", isotherms unchanged. So no published RH90 equilibrium humid capacity exists — our ruler measures something genuinely unmeasured, not a re-confirmation.
Uptake: 11 / 5.5 / 3.6 mmol/g at 195/273/303 K, 1 bar (3.6 is 303 K, not 298 K); 8.2 mmol/g at 10 bar 298 K; HOA 34 kJ/mol zero-loading -> 26-28. 0.15 bar value: 미확인 (not in either full text).
OMS: refuted as a risk. Structure is "corner-sharing nickel dimers and isolated octahedral nickel centres", µ-aqua bridged, all Ni saturated; paper explicitly contrasts itself with OMS materials. CCDC 1017488 (10.5517/ccdc.csd.cc134s67): catena-[tetrakis(µ-aqua)-octadecakis(µ-isonicotinato)-diaqua-nona-nickel MeOH THF solvate tetrahydrate].
(B) FIT. Positive: rigid, no OMS, no chemisorption, no gating; the authors' own rigid GCMC with UFF framework LJ reproduced experimental 298 K CO2 to 10 bar and the HOA — our exact pipeline is pre-validated on this material. CIF exists.
Three hazards. (1) "PyC units were strongly disordered... modeled using a head-tail orientation" — the base itself is an ensemble, so the ladder baseline carries batch spread before any substitution. (2) Pores 3.5/4.8 Å (PALS 3.9-4.4 Å): 2-amino/3-hydroxy/2-chloro/3-nitro isonicotinate almost certainly drives PLD under our 3.3 Å gate — the ladder may die at the Zeo++ gate. Test this first, it is cheap. (3) Framework contains 6 coordinated H2O per Ni9; guest TIP5P-Ew vs framework water H typing must be registered (WATER_FIX class of trap), and RH90 water insertion into 3.5 Å pores will sample badly at 5k+15k cycles.
result.corrected_numbers: JACS year 2017 (not 2016), 139(5):1734-1737. PE 655 kJ/kg CO2 — confirmed. "7% loss under humid conditions" — confirmed wording, but it is a BREAKTHROUGH result at unstated RH/T (SI paywalled), not an equilibrium humid capacity. ">85% RH, 7 days" and "6 months air" — confirmed, but these are dry-isotherm-after-exposure stability tests. Only in-situ humid CO2 datum: ~30% RH, 48 h (Sci Adv). CO2 uptake 1 bar: 3.6 mmol/g at 303 K (NOT 298 K), 5.5 at 273 K, 11 at 195 K; 8.2 mmol/g at 10 bar/298 K. HOA 34 kJ/mol at zero loading, 26 at ~2 mmol/g, ~28 at high loading. BET 945 m2/g. Pores 3.5 and 4.8 A (DFT on 195 K CO2 branch), PALS 3.9-4.4 A. CO2 self-diffusivity ~3e-9 m2/s. Uptake at 0.15 bar/298 K: 미확인.
result.cif_and_positions: CIF: CCDC 1017488, DataCite DOI 10.5517/ccdc.csd.cc134s67, deposited against Sci Adv 10.1126/sciadv.1500421. Formula per node: catena-[tetrakis(mu-aqua)-octadecakis(mu-isonicotinato)-diaqua-nona-nickel] + MeOH/THF/4H2O guest (must be desolvated; the 4 mu-H2O and 2 terminal H2O are FRAMEWORK, keep them). Single-crystal solution, but the ditopic pyridylcarboxylate is strongly disordered and was modelled head-tail — the deposited CIF needs an ordering decision per linker before PACMAN/GFN-FF, and each ordering is a distinct realization (register this as an ensemble axis, like the MTV batches). No CCDC entry found for any substituted-isonicotinate analogue of this net; whether 2-amino/3-hydroxy/2-chloro/3-nitro isonicotinate gives the same 6-connected Ni9 net is 미확인 — substitution positions available on the ring are 2,3,5,6, all of which point into the 3.5/4.8 A channels.
result.effectiveness_for_our_ruler: Meaningful, with one reframing. Our ruler (0.15 bar CO2, 298 K, RH90, TSA 298->373 K, retention RH90/RH0) is NOT a re-measurement of a published claim here: the literature has only 30% RH in-situ coadsorption and a dry-isotherm stability test after >85% RH exposure. So an RH90 equilibrium retention number for Ni-4PyC is a new result, and the headline "only 7% loss when wet" is exactly the kind of breakthrough-vs-equilibrium conflation our ruler was built to break. Physics fit is the best in the sweep so far: rigid, no OMS, no chemisorption, no gating, and the Woo group already showed rigid GCMC with UFF framework LJ reproduces the 298 K CO2 isotherm to 10 bar — our pipeline is pre-validated on this exact material, which no other candidate offers. TSA to 373 K is safe (activation at 100 C for 24 h is the reported protocol). Against: HOA 26-34 kJ/mol with polar carboxylate/aqua-lined 3.5 A channels means water will compete hard, and the ultramicropores make RH90 TIP5P-Ew insertion acceptance very low — 5k+15k cycles is likely under-converged, so the retention number may be sampling-limited rather than physics-limited. And the substitution ladder, our actual method, is the weak leg: substituents sit on ring positions that line a 3.5 A pore, so the Zeo++ PLD>3.3 A gate plausibly kills most rungs. Concrete 2-week path: (1) days 1-2, build 3-5 head-tail orderings of CCDC 1017488, xtb GFN-FF relax, PACMAN, Zeo++ — establish base PLD spread; (2) day 2, cheap Zeo++-only screen of the four substituted linkers at 25/50/100% to see if any rung survives the gate — REGISTER the stop rule before looking; (3) if a rung survives, RH0 and RH90 GCMC on base + that rung, 5 realizations, 298 and 373 K. If step 2 fails, report Ni-4PyC base alone as a validation point against the published dry isotherm and spend nothing more. Base-only (RH0/RH90 x 298/373 K, 5 orderings = 20 jobs) fits comfortably in 24 cores x 2 weeks; the full ladder does not.

result.findings:
(A) EVIDENCE. Identity confirmed: Li/Chung/Snurr, Langmuir 2016 ref 53 = Banerjee, Zhang, Plonka, Li, Parise, Cryst. Growth Des. 2012, 12, 2162–2165 (Crossref) = SBMOF-1 = Ca(SDB) = CSD ZERQOE. Screening full text read (OSTI 1476387).

Numbers 확인 but conditions 정정. Table 1: ZERQOE VF 0.25, LCD 4.5 Å (Zeo++), calc SA 315 m²/g, exp SA not reported; CO2/H2O sel 80, CO2/N2 78; Table 2 rank 1/15 by GCMC. But the "80" is a ternary CO2/H2O/N2 GCMC at 1 bar total, CO2:N2 = 1:9 → p_CO2 = 0.1 bar, RH 80 % (p_H2O fixed 3280 Pa), UFF + TraPPE CO2 + TIP4P water, EQeq/REPEAT charges, 5,109 CoRE MOFs → 2,927 → top 15. Two statements kill the transfer: "below 0.2 bar, water molecules adsorb inside ZERQOE and PARMIG, but HAWZEM does not… HAWZEM is more hydrophobic than ZERQOE," and "PARMIG and HAWZEM are better choices, because these MOFs adsorb more CO2 than ZERQOE." The authors themselves deprioritize ZERQOE on capacity, and its water exclusion fails exactly in our pressure window (0.15 bar, RH 90 > their 80).

Experimental humid CO2 isotherm: 미확인 (none found, Crossref/Europe PMC). Experimental water isotherm: none — Nat Commun 2016 (PMC4909987) measured only a Xe/Kr breakthrough at 42 % RH (Xe ~11.5 mmol/kg retained).

(B) FIT. Positives: "absence of open metal sites" stated explicitly (PMC4909987); no chemisorption; CIF available (CCDC 1475229–1475230, CoRE MOF ZERQOE); small cell → cheap.

Blockers: (1) No ladder. SDB's sulfone is the linker backbone, not a peripheral substituent; no isostructural Ca oxydibenzoate/thiodibenzoate found. Channel is 1D, largest included sphere 4.2 Å — any ring substituent closes it below our PLD 3.3 Å gate. PLD itself 미확인. Fixed-topology ensembles of 5 realizations have nothing to permute → batch-단위 statistics inapplicable. (2) Ca is absent from our UFF_MOF (verified: 57 mixing terms, 29 pseudo-atoms, no Ca_); adding it breaks both ff_gate.py gates and the frozen-FF contract. (3) VF 0.25 / 315 m²/g commensurate ultramicropore is the wrong shape for a 298→373 K TSA swing.
result.effectiveness_for_our_ruler: Low. The ruler needs (i) humid working capacity 298→373 K, (ii) RH90/RH0 retention, (iii) absolute uptake at 0.15 bar — and SBMOF-1 is weak on (i) and (iii) by the screening paper's own account (lower CO2 than PARMIG/HAWZEM; VF 0.25, 315 m²/g, 4.2–4.5 Å 1D channel → high Qst, poor 373 K release). Its one selling point, (ii), is quoted at 1 bar/RH80 where CO2 has already displaced water; the same figure shows water entering below 0.2 bar, i.e. our operating point. More decisively, the project's method is fixed-topology linker-substitution ladders with 5-realization ensembles: SBMOF-1 admits no ladder (single backbone linker, no reported analogue, sub-gate PLD headroom), so it cannot produce ensemble or 배치 단위 statistics — at best one isolated data point costing a frozen force-field edit (Ca UFF params) that would break comparability with the ZIF-69 v3 series. Recommend spending the 2-week window elsewhere; if a hydrophobic ultramicropore comparator is genuinely wanted, HAWZEM (rank 3, more hydrophobic, higher CO2 by the same paper) is the better candidate to re-sweep, and it should be judged on whether IT admits a substitution ladder.

result.cif_and_positions: CIF available. Primary structure: Banerjee/Parise 2012, Cryst. Growth Des. 12, 2162–2165 (10.1021/cg300274n), CSD refcode ZERQOE. Re-determinations deposited with Nat Commun 2016: CCDC 1475229–1475230 (www.ccdc.cam.ac.uk/data_request/cif), plus supplementary CIFs in that paper. Structure: space group P2_1/c (PMC4909987); corner-sharing octahedrally coordinated Ca chains bridged by 4,4'-sulfonyldibenzoate, giving 1D non-intersecting channels; largest included hard-sphere diameter 4.2 Å; saturation ~2 Xe per unit cell (1.72 Xe/cell crystallographically, ~1.25 mmol/g). Unit cell lattice parameters and atom count per cell: 미확인 (not in the main text of either opened source; would need the CIF itself). No open metal sites and no framework-coordinated water in the activated form (explicit statement, PMC4909987) — so PACMAN DDEC6 charging and rigid-framework GCMC are formally applicable. Practical caveat for our pipeline: a 1D commensurate ultramicroporous channel with LCD ≈ pore-limiting size makes GCMC insertion acceptance very low; the 5,000 + 15,000 cycle budget calibrated on ZIF-69 (2×2×2, PLD ≫ 3.3 Å) is not guaranteed to converge here, and the Zeo++ PLD > 3.3 Å gate has not been evaluated for this structure at all.

result.findings:
(A) EVIDENCE — sweep record largely confirmed, one correction. Source = Li, Chung & Snurr, Langmuir 2016, 32, 10368 (10.1021/acs.langmuir.6b02803), full text via OSTI 1476387. Table 1: HAWZEM VF 0.47, LCD 4.8 Å, calculated SA 951 m²/g, experimental SA absent (footnote a: "the original paper does not report the experimental surface area"), CO2/H2O selectivity 43, CO2/N2 53. Text: "below 0.2 bar, water molecules adsorb inside ZERQOE and PARMIG, but HAWZEM does not adsorb water" over 0.1–1 bar. CORRECTION: "#3" is the GCMC(REPEAT) rank only; by Henry's-law ranks it is 8th (REPEAT) and 12th (EQeq). Conditions differ from ours: TIP4P water, UFF+TraPPE, EQeq/REPEAT charges, RH 80 % as fixed p_H2O = 3280 Pa, CO2:N2 = 1:9. Hydrophobicity is model-dependent — after WATER_FIX (8.6× affinity error from one H term) a TIP4P "no uptake" does not transfer to TIP5P-Ew/DDEC6.
Provenance confirmed: Lian & Chen, Inorg. Chem. Commun. 2012, 18, 8–10 (10.1016/j.inoche.2011.12.041), "A new microporous Cu(II)-isonicotinate framework with 8-connected bcu topology". No experimental CO2, water or 0.15 bar data found anywhere (미확인 — abstract publisher-withheld; no isotherms in MOFX-DB).
IISERP-MOF2 is NOT this material: Ni9(μ-H2O)4(H2O)2(4-pyridylcarboxylate)18, saturated Ni, pores 3.5/4.8 Å (Sci Adv 2015, PMC4730842). Same linker only — a cousin, not an analogue; it, not HAWZEM, carries the humid evidence (160 h steam, 48 h humid CO2 at 30 % RH).
(B) FIT — OMS does not refute. I parsed the CoRE CIF myself: Cu is 2 O (1.96/1.98) + 2 N (2.01) equatorial, plus framework carboxylate O at 2.31 and 2.91 Å — Jahn-Teller 4+1+1, no pore-facing vacancy; composition Cu4C48H32N8O16 = exactly Cu(INA)2, so nothing coordinated was stripped. CIF is free (MOFX-DB 170368/177210). PLD 3.74 Å, LCD 4.84 Å.
What kills it is the ladder. Our method is fixed-topology linker substitution + 5-realization batch statistics. HAWZEM is single-ligand: MTV needs ≥2 linker types, and any ring substituent (even F) intrudes on a 3.74 Å window that CO2 (3.30 Å) barely clears — every rung is pore-blocked, so the ensemble/batch-단위 machinery has nothing to measure. Rigid-framework GCMC is also least defensible exactly here, and our frozen 5,000/15,000 cycles were tuned for ZIF-69-scale pores; ultramicropore + TIP5P-Ew insertion acceptance likely leaves RH90 unconverged, and §1 forbids raising cycles. No experimental porosity means we could not even tell a wrong answer from a right one. Cost is not the objection: 108 atoms/cell, 2×2×2 ≈ 864 atoms, cheaper than ZIF-69 v3.

No vacant pore-facing axial site => the OMS refutation test FAILS TO FIRE; MOFX-DB carries no OMS field either way, so this geometric check is the evidence. Substitution sites: ring positions 2,3,5,6 of isonicotinate are chemically free, but geometrically unusable at PLD 3.741 Å. 2x2x2 supercell ~ 864 atoms, cell edges ~23.4/24.5/25.0 Å, all > 2 x 12 Å cutoff — protocol-compatible.
result.effectiveness_for_our_ruler: Low. Our ruler (RH90 humid working capacity 298->373 K + RH90/RH0 retention + 0.15 bar absolute uptake) is measurable on HAWZEM as a single point — the CIF is free, the cell is small and cheap, Cu has no open site, PLD 3.74 Å clears our >3.3 Å gate, and PACMAN/xtb/RASPA would all run. But a single point is not a study. The deliverable our method produces is a substitution ladder with 5-realization ensembles judged on the batch 단위 scale; HAWZEM is a single-ligand framework with a 3.74 Å window, so there is no rung to climb: any 2/3/5/6-ring substituent occludes a window CO2 (3.30 Å) already barely passes, and MTV needs a second linker type that does not exist here. The one thing it might be worth — a hydrophobic RH90 reference point against ZIF-69 base (RH0 0.5839 mol/kg) — is exactly the number our frozen 5,000/15,000-cycle protocol is least likely to converge in an ultramicropore under TIP5P-Ew, and there is no experimental porosity (no reported experimental surface area, no isotherm anywhere) to catch a wrong answer. Recommendation: do not open a HAWZEM lane in the 2-week window. If a hydrophobic control is wanted later, register it explicitly as a 1-structure, 2-run control (RH0 + RH90, no ensemble, no ladder) rather than as a candidate, and state up front that a non-converged result will be reported as 미확인, not as a ranking.

result.findings:
(A) EVIDENCE. Faraday Discuss. 2017 (10.1039/c7fd00017k, Crossref abstract opened) confirms MCIF-1 = [Cu2(DCI)2](MeCN), Cu(I)/dicyanoimidazolate, room-temperature scalable, crystalline after ~1 week in water, pH 0–13.5. The abstract reports no porosity or gas adsorption; I found no experimental CO2 isotherm, BET, or pore data for MCIF-1 in any source I could open (RSC full text 403; 11 citing papers, none reporting MCIF-1 CO2). 미확인.

All numbers below are simulation, recovered from Kwon's figshare/SI (opened), not experiment. Kwon's screened structure is JAWXEN01 (not JAWXEN as the figure caption says) with full solvent removal. Zeo++: PLD 3.744 Å, LCD 4.218 Å, SA 1352 m²/g, PV 0.345 cm³/g, void 0.434, ρ 1258 kg/m³. FastMC CO2 298 K: 1.500 mmol/g @0.1 bar, 2.549 @0.2 → ~2.0 mmol/g at 0.15 bar; N2 0.0281 @0.1 bar; HoA(CO2) 29.76, HoA(N2) 9.34 kJ/mol. Ternary CO2/N2/H2O at 40 % RH: 15 % CO2 case dry 1.748 → wet 1.930 mmol/g (retention 110 %), H2O 0.0178 mmol/g, CO2/H2O 109; 35 % case 3.664 → 3.608 (98.5 %), CO2/H2O 210. Kwon reports it only as a 1D-channel exemplar; no per-material text claim. Kwon's own table lists MCIF-1 among 23 experimentally water-stable MOFs and MOFSimplify predicts solvent-removal "Unstable" (p 0.43) and acid-stability "Unstable" (p 0.34) — its ML disagrees with the experiment.

(B) FIT. Modelable: no OMS (Kwon excluded OMS before this MOF passed), rigid, physisorptive, HoA 30 kJ/mol, PLD passes our 3.3 Å gate, ~88 atoms/cell (2×2×2 ≈ 704 atoms) so cheap. Fatal to the method, not the material: the 4,5-positions carry the nitriles that are almost certainly the second Cu donor set (stoichiometry Cu:imidazolate-N = 1:2 leaves Cu 2-coordinate otherwise), so the claimed CN/NO2/Cl/H 4,5-ladder would destroy the topology. Only C2-H is substitutable, and any group there closes a 3.74 Å channel. So no ensemble, no batch statistics — n=1.
result.effectiveness_for_our_ruler: Partial. Our registered ruler (0.15 bar, 298 K, RH90 humid TSA 298→373 K working capacity + RH90/RH0 retention + absolute uptake) is meaningful here and, crucially, unmeasured: Kwon stops at 40 % RH and never runs TSA. A hydrophobic 1D-channel material that gains CO2 at 40 % RH is exactly the case where RH90 is the discriminating test, and we would produce the first such number. Absolute uptake ~2.0 mmol/g (simulated, FastMC/different force field) is ~3.4× our ZIF-69 base 0.5839 mol/kg, so it would sit far above the reference — but that is a cross-code comparison and must be re-run under our contract (UFF_MOF + Garcia-Sanchez CO2 + TIP5P-Ew with the 2026-09-06 Hw/Lw none fix) before any ranking. What does NOT work is our method: "linker substitution ladders + ensembles of 5 realizations + batch statistics" has no substrate here. The framework is fully ordered with one linker and one substitutable position; there is no mixing disorder, so batch SD is undefined and "배치 단위" cannot be computed. Every comparison would be an n=1 single-structure comparison judged only on the ± (95 % CI) ruler, i.e. 1.5 × ±. Realistic 2-week cost: small — ~700 atoms in 2×2×2, dry + RH90 at 298 and 373 K, so 4–6 state points; on 24 cores this is a few days, not the window. Recommended scope: run it as a single hydrophobic reference point (dry 0.15 bar, RH90 retention, TSA WC) alongside the ZIF-69 ladder, register the criterion before reading results, and explicitly drop the MTV-ladder ambition. Do not spend ensemble compute on it.
result.corrected_numbers: Sweep-record corrections. (1) Refcode: the structure with data is JAWXEN01, not JAWXEN; Kwon's Figure 7 caption says "MCIF-1 (JAWXEN)" but every isotherm, geometry and process row in the dataset is JAWXEN01_full_repeat. (2) "MTV ladder at the imidazolate 4,5-positions (CN/NO2/Cl/H)" is wrong: the 4,5-positions are the two nitriles, which the 1:1 Cu:DCI stoichiometry implies are coordinating (8 Cu, 8 imidazolate = 16 imidazolate N per cell would leave Cu 2-coordinate). Only the C2-H is free; call it a 1-position ladder, and note substituents there shrink a 3.744 Å PLD below the 3.3 Å gate. (3) "Survived the 40 % RH multicomponent GCMC filter" is right but understated/overstated in places: retention is 1.104 at 15 % CO2 (uptake rises with water) and 0.985 at 35 % CO2, with water uptake 0.0178 / 0.0172 mmol/g — essentially hydrophobic. (4) "No experimental CO2 data" — confirmed; also no experimental BET/PLD found. All porosity numbers in circulation are Zeo++ on the desolvated model, not measurement. (5) Kwon reports no headline performance number for MCIF-1 in text; the process numbers exist only in SI: min energy 191.9 kWhe/tonne at 15 % CO2 (94.8 % purity, 89.5 % recovery), 68.8 at 35 %, 589.7 at 6 %. (6) Derived cross-check: 1445.1 g/mol per unit cell = 4 × Cu2(DCI)2, i.e. Z = 4, 88 atoms/cell, confirming the model is guest-free Cu(DCI) with no residual MeCN.
result.cif_and_positions:
CIF availability is a real friction point, not a blocker. The simulation-ready CIF Kwon used comes from MOSAEC-DB (Chem. Sci. 2025, 10.1039/D4SC07438F), deposited at Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14025238 — I opened the record and its FILES ARE ACCESS-RESTRICTED ("publicly accessible record, restricted files; log in to check access"), so the exact JAWXEN01_full_repeat CIF cannot be downloaded anonymously; it needs a Zenodo access request or re-derivation. The underlying crystal structure is CSD refcodes JAWXEN / JAWXEN01; CCDC Access Structures is behind a CAPTCHA (I hit it) and DataCite has no CCDC deposition DOI indexed for either refcode, so retrieval needs CSD/ConQuest access or a CCDC request. No CIF was obtained in this pass — treat "CIF in hand" as 미확인.

Desolvated phase: no experimentally reported activated/desolvated structure was found. Kwon's "_full" model is a computational full-solvent-removal of the as-synthesized MeCN-containing crystal, and my mass check (1445.1 g/mol/cell = 4 × Cu2(DCI)2, 88 atoms) confirms the MeCN was stripped in silico only. Whether MCIF-1 survives activation is untested in anything I opened; Kwon's own MOFSimplify prediction flags solvent-removal stability as "Unstable" (p 0.43, "Uncertain"). Cell volume derived from density: ~1907 Å3, so 2×2×2 comfortably exceeds the 12 Å cutoff.

Cu(I) oxidation risk: 미확인 for the solid. The nearest evidence is J. Colloid Interface Sci. 2023 (10.1016/j.jcis.2023.09.014), which deliberately air-oxidizes CuI/cyanoimidazole in DMSO to make amorphous Cu(II)-cyanoimidazole frameworks — suggestive that Cu(I) dicyanoimidazolate chemistry oxidizes in solution, but it starts from CuI, not from MCIF-1, so it is not direct evidence against the framework. In any case oxidation, like chemisorption and framework flexibility, is outside what our rigid-framework GCMC can model; it must be carried as a written caveat, not simulated.
